title: doellingeria rugulosa
intro: Doellingeria rugulosa, commonly known as the White Tansy or Mountain Tansy, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and anti-spasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Doellingeria rugulosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
